study_identification_part.si_4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 326 MS patients from 5 datasets: (1) MSSEG2016 - MICCAI 2016 challenge public dataset (N=53), (2) OpenMSLong - public dataset (N=20), (3) CHUV - in-house from Lausanne University Hospital (N=41), (4) NIL - in-house from Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (N=47), (5) INsIDER - in-house Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in MS dataset (N=165). Additionally, the CentileBrain normative model trained on 37,407 healthy individuals from 81 external datasets was used as the reference normative model (not trained in this study).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We analyzed a heterogeneous dataset comprising 326 MS patients from five sources: three in-house datasets (Lausanne University Hospital (CHUV), Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (NIL), and Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in Multiple Sclerosis (INsIDER)) and two public datasets (MICCAI-MSSEG2016 challenge and OpenMSLong)." ... "the CentileBrain model trained with 37,407 healthy individuals (53.3% females, age range 3-90) from 81 datasets has been released."
